title: 第5章 小鬼第6章 进城
content_zh:
“这可怎么办啊“？
翠翠在屋里来回踱步很是焦虑
“税钱我已经交了”
杨威拿着一个馍馍吃着，很是随意开口道
“什么？威哥你莫要哄我嘞……
脚步声马上便停了转而是少女的一系列疑惑
不怪她惊讶毕竟户籍税是整整三两银子
这里货币的基本面值为黄金，白银，铜板，铜板是面值最小的计量单位
一两黄金可以换十两白银，一两白银则可换一千五百文铜钱
官家的税款统一收的是银子，想要用铜板换银子往往还需多出些做手续费给钱庄
平日里翠翠到处做工一天才十几文钱，不吃不喝一年才够交的
“你应该还没吃饭吧，来一起吃点吧”
不等翠翠疑惑杨威揭开桌上的竹罩，只见其上摆着一盘色泽鲜艳的红烧肉
“我今天出去打猎，端了一窝野猪，大的换成银子交税，几只小的就带了回来，这是其中一只让饭店加工出来的”
杨威说着指了指墙壁上挂着的弓箭，墙角下还有着一个带血麻袋里面装着几只小野猪
这下翠翠是真惊了自家男人大难不死后简直成了神人啊，困扰他们家的难题竟然如此轻易就被解决了
震惊过后，得到答案的翠翠也不细问，一人一个馍配着肉便吃了起来
自从猎户父亲走了，两人就很少开荤了，有些留存下来的腊肉也全吃完了
这顿饭翠翠吃的很开心，自家小男人终于支楞起来了，对于这个家来说就如大火中的一场倾盆大雨
杨威倒没有说谎，他易容成朱四走出红林村后便顺道去了一趟山里

表现出掌握了打猎技巧主要是掩人耳目顺便实验一下这具躯体的法术契合度
施展几招基本的下等功法没有任何问题，只是境界还太低法力很快便会见底，无法长时间与人斗法
哪怕是面对亲近之人杨威也不会轻易暴露出全部，这么多世从来没将自己是重生者告诉过任何人。
杨威静静吃着目光看向翠翠，准确说看的是她的左边肩膀
一只通体乌黑胎毛稀疏的婴儿正趴在她的肩头，乌溜溜的眼睛好奇的打量着屋内一切
这诡异的婴儿肚脐上还连着一根脐带虚影一直延伸到门外
这是魂魄与阴气凝聚成的阴灵，凡人将他们统称为鬼
婴儿的魂魄本就脆弱，不可能长时间存在于阳间
这小家伙明显是被人炼化了的使徒，背后定还有着操纵之人或是更为强大的邪祟
从翠翠进屋时杨威便注意到了这小鬼，只是不知对方为何跟着翠翠，是否冲着自己来的？
好在从气息看这阴灵使徒实力并不强，否则他就真要先走为上了
“翠姐今天辛苦了，我来给你按摩吧”
杨威放下筷子不等答应已经来到其身后
凡人是看不见阴物的，在翠翠看来杨威就如真给他按摩一般两只手搭在她肩上
虽然有些奇怪杨威为何一下如此体贴却也不没有反抗
“威哥什么时候这么会疼娘子了？
伴随舒缓节奏翠翠放松双肩，嘴里不乏溢美之词，渐渐的她感到有些困意不一会儿就趴在桌上睡着了
杨威手上泛着绿光刚才他发动了催眠法术，不仅是翠翠被催眠了，趴在她肩上阴灵也合上双眼被短暂麻痹了
想找到这使徒的主人非常容易只需顺着脐带虚影寻找便可
杨威没打算一股脑的冲上去与对方大战而是想要先摸清对方的底细

多世的经验让他面对危机之时也能淡定自若保持清醒
要想观察敌人首先不能打草惊蛇，朝自身打出一道隐匿术法后杨威身体近乎透明
content_en:
"What should I do?"
Cuicui was pacing back and forth in the room, feeling very anxious.
"I have already paid the tax"
Yang Wei was eating a steamed bun and said casually
"What? Brother Wei, please don't coax me...
The footsteps immediately stopped and turned into a series of doubts from the girl.
Don't blame her for being surprised. After all, the household registration tax is a full three taels of silver.
The basic face values of currency here are gold, silver, and copper plates. Copper plates are the unit of measurement with the smallest face value.
One tael of gold can be exchanged for ten taels of silver, and one tael of silver can be exchanged for 1,500 copper coins.
Official taxes are all collected in silver. If you want to exchange copper plates for silver, you often have to pay more handling fees to the bank.
On weekdays, Cuicui works everywhere for only a dozen pennies a day. It would take a year without food or water to make enough.
"You probably haven't eaten yet, come and have something together."
Before Cuicui could be confused, Yang Wei opened the bamboo cover on the table and saw a plate of brightly colored braised pork on it.
"I went hunting today and brought a bunch of wild boars. I exchanged the big ones for money and paid taxes. I brought back a few small ones. This is one of them that was processed by the hotel."
Yang Wei said and pointed to the bows and arrows hanging on the wall. Under the corner was a bloody sack containing several small wild boars.
Now Cuicui was really shocked that her man had become a god after surviving the catastrophe. The problems that plagued their family were solved so easily.
After being shocked, Cuicui got the answer and started eating one steamed bun with meat and no more questions.
Since Orion's father left, the two of them rarely eat meat, and some of the preserved bacon has been eaten up.
Cuicui enjoyed this meal very happily. Her little man finally became frightened. To this family, it was like a downpour in a fire.
Yang Wei didn't lie. After he walked out of Honglin Village disguised as Zhu Si, he took a trip to the mountains.
Showing mastery of hunting skills is mainly to deceive others and test the body's spell compatibility.
There is no problem in performing a few basic low-level skills, but the level is still too low and the magic power will bottom out soon, making it impossible to fight with others for a long time.
Even when facing people close to him, Yang Wei would not reveal everything easily. He had never told anyone that he was a reborn person in so many lives.
Yang Wei ate quietly and looked at Cuicui, to be precise, he was looking at her left shoulder.
A black baby with sparse fetal hair was lying on her shoulder, its dark eyes curiously looking at everything in the room.
There is an umbilical cord attached to this weird baby's belly button, which extends all the way to the door.
These are Yin spirits condensed from soul and Yin energy. Mortals collectively call them ghosts.
The soul of a baby is inherently fragile and cannot exist in the earthly world for a long time.
This little guy is obviously a refined apostle, and there must be someone manipulating him or a more powerful evil spirit behind him.
Yang Wei noticed the kid when he entered the house from Cuicui, but he didn't know why he followed Cuicui. Was he coming for him?
Fortunately, judging from the aura, this Yin Ling Apostle is not very strong, otherwise he would really have taken the lead.
"Sister Cui, you have worked hard today, let me give you a massage."
Yang Wei put down his chopsticks and came behind him without waiting for permission.
Mortals can't see vaginal objects. From Cuicui's point of view, Yang Wei put his hands on her shoulders as if she were really giving him a massage.
Although it was a little strange why Yang Wei was so considerate, he didn't resist.
“Since when did Brother Wei know how to love my wife so much?
With the soothing rhythm, Cuicui relaxed her shoulders, and there were many beautiful words in her mouth. Gradually, she felt a little sleepy, and soon she fell asleep on the table.
Yang Wei's hand glowed with green light. He had just activated the hypnosis spell. Not only was Cuicui hypnotized, but the Yin spirit lying on her shoulder also closed its eyes and was temporarily paralyzed.
It is very easy to find the owner of this apostle, just follow the shadow of the umbilical cord and look for it
Yang Wei did not intend to rush forward to fight with the opponent, but wanted to find out the details of the opponent first.
Many lifetimes of experience have enabled him to remain calm and sober in the face of crisis.
wantIf you want to observe the enemy, you must not alert the enemy first. After casting a concealment spell on himself, Yang Wei's body is almost transparent.
